bio: BIG HEAVY STUFF WERE A SYDNEY INDIE ROCK BAND WITH A KNACK FOR MASSIVE GUITARS, BIG MELODIES AND SONGS THAT COULD FEEL BOTH HEAVY AND BEAUTIFUL AT THE SAME TIME. THROUGH THE ’90S AND EARLY 2000S THEY BUILT A DEVOTED FOLLOWING WITH THEIR DISTINCTIVE MIX OF FUZZ, EMOTION AND SMART, HOOKY SONGWRITING
